proves.claim: an edge file in packages/codemap/data/edges declares its edge like an allowedEdges entry, and an unused one is reported naming the file to delete

gate.io-edges-allowed.an-edge-file-decla.why: Without this case the one-edge files that keep env/fs slices from conflicting on the cells plan list could stop allowing their imports unnoticed.

proves.claim: an edge file that declares no edge, is not named after its edge, or repeats an allowedEdges entry is refused

gate.io-edges-allowed.a-bad-or-twice-dec.why: Without this case one edge could be declared twice or under a second name, and the one-path-per-edge rule that stops duplicate edges would not hold.
